.lp .am:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(10,26,63,.08)}

.lp .am i:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:11px;top:7px;width:6px;height:12px;border:solid var(--gold);border-width:0 2.2px 2.2px 0;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.lp .near{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:20px}
.lp .nr{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E6EAF2;border-radius:14px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(10,26,63,.04)}
.lp .nr b{display:block;font-family:Lora,Georgia,serif;font-size:28px;color:var(--gold-deep)}
.lp .agentcard{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 20px}
.lp .agentcard img{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(10,26,63,.15);flex:none}
.lp .agentcard b{display:block;font-size:18px}
.lp .agentcard span{color:#4A5370;font-size:15px}
.lp details{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E6EAF2;border-radius:14px;padding:0;margin-bottom:12px;transition:box-shadow .2s}

.lp summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.lp summary:after{content:"+";position:absolute;right:18px;top:50%;width:28px;height:28px;margin-top:-14px;border-radius:50%;background:#FDECEE;color:var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:20px;font-weight:500;line-height:1;transition:transform .2s}
.lp details[open] summary:after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.lp details p{padding:0 20px 18px}
.lp .intro2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.lp .intro2 .desc{max-width:none}
.lp .ifig{margin:0;min-height:460px;height:100%;border-radius:20px;background:var(--navy) center/cover no-repeat;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(10,26,63,.18)}
@media (max-width:860px){.lp .intro2{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}.lp .ifig{min-height:300px}}
.lp .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}.lp .rv.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lp .rv{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}}
@media print{.lp .rv{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.lp details p{margin:10px 0 0;color:#1d2440;line-height:1.7}
.lp .contact{background:radial-gradient(900px 400px at 100% 0,rgba(220,28,46,.22),transparent 60%),linear-gradient(160deg,#0A1A3F,#132A5E);color:#fff}
.lp .contact h2{color:#fff}.lp .contact .kick{color:var(--on-navy-accent)}
.lp .contact .agentcard{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:18px;padding:16px 20px;max-width:520px}
.lp .contact .agentcard img{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.lp .contact .agentcard span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.lp .contact label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}

.lp .contact .note{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}.lp .contact .note b{color:#fff}
.lp .contact [data-out]{color:#fff}
.lp button.wa{font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
@media (min-width:900px){.lp .contact .in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr;column-gap:64px;align-items:start}.lp .contact .in>*{grid-column:1}.lp .contact .in>form{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/span 6;max-width:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:20px;padding:24px}}
.lp form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;max-width:720px}
.lp form .full{grid-column:1/-1}
.lp label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}
.lp input,.lp textarea{font:inherit;border:1px solid #D3D8E3;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 14px;color:var(--ink)}
.lp .go{margin-top:6px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}

.lp .foot .in{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;opacity:.85}
.lp .float{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:5;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25);padding:12px 20px;font-size:15px;animation:waPulse 2.4s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes waPulse{0%{box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,.55)}70%{box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 0 0 16px rgba(37,211,102,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,0)}}
.lp .wa svg{flex:none}
.lp .wcta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px 18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px;padding:18px 20px 18px 18px;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #E4E8F0;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(10,26,63,.07);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.lp .wcta:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:4px;background:linear-gradient(#25D366,#1EAE55)}
.lp .wcta .wi{flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:#E9F8EF;color:#1A9E4B;display:grid;place-items:center}.lp .wcta .wi svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.lp .wcta p{margin:0;font-size:14px;color:#56607A;text-align:left;flex:1 1 220px;line-height:1.45}.lp .wcta p b{display:block;font-family:Lora,serif;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:2px}
.lp .wcta .wa{padding:11px 18px;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(37,211,102,.28);transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}.lp .wcta .wa:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(37,211,102,.35)}

.lp .nudge{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:calc(82px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:6;width:min(330px,calc(100vw - 36px));background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(10,26,63,.25);padding:16px 16px 14px;animation:nudgeIn .35s ease-out}
.lp .nudge .nh{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;padding-right:22px}
.lp .nudge .nh img,.lp .nudge .nh i{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;flex:none;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.lp .nudge .nh b{display:block;font-size:15px}.lp .nudge .nh span{font-size:12px;color:#1E9E50;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}.lp .nudge .nh span:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#25D366}
.lp .nudge p{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;background:#F1F3F8;border-radius:4px 14px 14px 14px;padding:10px 12px}
.lp .nudge .wa{width:100%;justify-content:center;box-sizing:border-box}
.lp .nudge .nx{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;width:30px;height:30px;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:20px;color:#7A8299;cursor:pointer;border-radius:50%}
@keyframes nudgeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lp .float,.lp .nudge{animation:none}}
.lp .zoom{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(5,10,25,.92);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;z-index:9;cursor:zoom-out}
.lp .zoom img{max-width:100%;max-height:calc(100% - 50px);border-radius:8px;cursor:default}
.lp .zoom .zn{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);background:rgba(10,26,63,.6);color:#fff;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}
.lp .zoom .zp{left:14px}.lp .zoom .zx{right:14px}
.lp .zoom .zc{position:absolute;bottom:18px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;color:#fff;font-size:14px;opacity:.85}
.lp .zoom .zq{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font-size:30px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1}
.lp .note{font-size:12px;color:#5a6178;margin-top:10px}
.lp .plan{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.lp .plan div{background:var(--paper);border-radius:12px;padding:18px;border-top:3px solid var(--gold)}
.lp .plan span{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5a6178;font-weight:600}
.lp .plan b{display:block;font-family:Lora,Georgia,serif;font-size:26px;margin:6px 0 2px;color:var(--ink)}
.lp .plan small{color:#4A5370;font-size:14px}
.lp .plan-sel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;max-width:360px}
.lp .plan-sel select{font:inherit;border:1px solid #D3D8E3;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 14px;color:var(--ink)}
.lp.vo{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}
.lp.vo img{-webkit-user-drag:none;user-drag:none}
@media print{.lp.vo,#c{display:none!important}}
@media (max-width:560px){.lp form{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lp .hero{min-height:480px}.lp .top nav{display:none}}
